exercises.instruction: You met these people at a party. The next day you tell a friend about these people. Complete the sentences using who or whose.

parts: I met somebody whose mother writes detective stories

answers: whose wife is an English teacher
whose ambition is to climb Everest
whose parents used to work in a circus

exercises.instruction: For each situation write a sentence with whom (more formal) and without whom (less formal).

parts: more formal I met a friend whom I hadn’t seen for years
. less formal I met a friend I hadn’t seen for years
answers: whom I hadn’t seen for years

parts: more formal I went to see a lawyer
. less formal I went to see a lawyer
answers: whom a friend of mine (had) recommended

parts: wasn’t very helpful. less formal The person
wasn’t in love with him. less formal The woman
answers: with whom Tom was in love

parts: We helped some people whose car had broken down
believes that all wars are wrong.
What’s the name of the hotel
This school is only for children
I bought my car is a friend of my father’s.
I live in a friendly village

exercises.instruction: Use your own ideas to complete these sentences.

items.prompt: I can’t meet you on Friday. That’s the day I’m going away.
modelAnswers: That’s the day I’m going away.

items.prompt: The reason ___________ was that the salary was too low.
modelAnswers: The reason I left my job was that the salary was too low.
I’ll never forget the time I got stuck in a lift.
2009 was the year Amanda got married.

items.prompt: The reason ___________ is that neither of them can drive.
modelAnswers: The reason they don’t have a car is that neither of them can drive.
The last time I saw Sam was about six months ago.
Do you remember the day we first met?
